identity.title: Make Wuji Guardian startup and config reload converge

values.goal: Make Wuji start reliably through CSM without a separate Guardian continuity-channel startup dependency.
values.required_outcome: One operator command starts or reloads Wuji, safely reconciles interrupted startup state, reaches stable HTTPS readiness on 20997, and remains supervised by the host service manager.
declared_scope: CSM Runtime v3 service start, stop, status, and reload commands
Guardian startup readiness and kernel lease ownership
Safe reconciliation of ownerless locks and interrupted startup journals
Focused local and AWS-facing readiness proof
authority_boundary: Guardian remains the Runtime process authority
Single-writer safety remains fail closed for genuine live writers
Retained Polis state and signed checkpoints are preserved
No separate port-20998 continuity channel is required for ordinary startup
operator_constraints: Fix forward and do not revert the current recovery work
Do not discard retained Wuji state
Keep validation focused and restore the always-on service
